Solutions by work

Put AI into the right workflow with the right authority

Each business function has different data, risk and output standards. The solution should therefore follow the work—not the tool name.

Opportunity map

Six common problem groups

These are discovery starting points, not a claim that every use case fits every business.

CEO & management

Executive briefing and decision preparation

Consolidate approved sources, summarise changes and prepare questions for meetings.

Start when reports are structured and source ownership is clear.
Sales

Account research and proposal preparation

Organise customer context, needs, interaction history and next actions.

Start when CRM or lead data is reasonably consistent.
Marketing

Brand-controlled content workflow

Turn a brief into an outline, draft, channel variants and approval checklist.

Start when voice, sources and reviewers are defined.
People

Policy retrieval and recruitment support

Help staff find the right material or compare profiles against approved criteria.

AI must not make the final employment decision.
Finance

Document extraction and preliminary checks

Read documents, standardise fields and flag cases for human review.

Requires access control and mandatory reconciliation.
Operations

Recurring reporting and exception alerts

Reduce repeated consolidation work and route missing-data alerts to the right owner.

Start when the process and business rules are stable.
Pre-build filter

A good use case must pass five questions

  • Where does the current problem create time, cost or risk?
  • Can inputs and outputs be described clearly?
  • Is the data available, usable and sufficiently reliable?
  • Who uses, approves and owns the outcome?
  • What evidence determines whether the pilot passes?
PRINCIPLE

AI supports decisions; it does not obscure accountability

Sensitive workflows need action limits, input validation, human approval, audit logs and incident handling.
